_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround mo {width}x{height} grid.
O o player {player_id}. Ditshwanelo tsa kgwebo: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kgotsa w/s/a/d.
Thelelo: tswelela pele go ba bangwe botlalo. Trails ke maswe; go thulana le lebala go robala; go thulana ka kgwoba go robala bobedi.

board.after_moves: Boto morago ga go tsamaya ka nako e le nngwe: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Player {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.survived_win: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a falola; ba bangwe botlhe ba ile ba wa.
outcome.all_crashed: Batshameki botlhe ba ne ba wa ka nako e le nngwe.
outcome.outlived: Motshameki mongwe o ne a tshela go feta ba bangwe botlhe.
outcome.turn_limit: Fa go fitlhetswe tekanyetso ya nako e o ka kgonang go falola mo motshamekong oo, ke ene a fenyang.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Tlhokomelo ya kgwebokgwebo ya boraro (e kgona ka botlalo→e sa kgone): {groups}
